Two identical purchases have no duplicate reference. Preserve both and keep leading-zero account IDs and the original PHP/USD currencies.

Two parts sum to the 50 parent. The separate 20 purchase survives. Currency comes only from explicit import context.
Different provider IDs prove two equal purchases; neither account leading zeros nor FITIDs may be lost.
Two statement sections have distinct currencies and accounts. Decimal comma amounts are 12.50 and 20, not 1250 or 2000.
Explicit DBIT/CRDT determine direction; preserve account and EUR, 850-24.90 = 825.10 movement.
Structured debit and credit fields, SGD and leading zeros are explicit in source.
Three timestamps identify three purchases. Generic OCR must preserve source and require review.

No currency evidence: total55 remains useful but currency must stay unresolved with a warning and capped confidence.
Explicit Rp and tender minus change confirm 10000 rupiah, not10.
YNAB opening balance is not income; Cleared/Reconciled is source evidence, never Clover user confirmation. Category and memo checks also run through the worker.
